_doc: Chatterbox (Resemble AI, MIT): copies a voice from about 10 s of a recording. `voice/clone.py --setup` installs it on the PC: its own venv (it pins torch 2.6.0, older than ComfyUI's) and these files from the official repo at a fixed revision, each checked against its size and sha256 (from the Hugging Face API). Everything it makes carries Resemble's inaudible watermark, so detectors can tell it is AI speech.
